name: Clockwork
description: Clockwork is a digital investment office for individuals, family offices, funds, and their advisors. Connect it to work with your portfolio directly in Claude: look up holdings and funds, review commitments, capital calls, distributions, and fees, pull performance metrics including IRR, MOIC, DPI, and TVPI, and read the notes, statements, and documents attached to each position. Claude can also write back, logging a new investment, recording a distribution, creating a company profile, tagging holdings, and building saved portfolios and views. Requires a Clockwork account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Clockwork to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Clockwork to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.clockwork.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Clockwork MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clockwork lists 42 MCP tools, including add-subject-tags, bulk-add-subject-tags, bulk-remove-subject-tags, create-contents, create-contents-filter, create-file-content, create-holdings, create-investment-accounts, create-investment-filter, create-list, create-subjects-filter, and create-template.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Clockwork?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Clockwork in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Clockwork requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Clockwork is developed by Clockwork Universe, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
